scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('public/build/manifest.json','utf8')); const js=m['resources/js/app.jsx'].file; const css=m['resources/css/app.css'].file; let html=fs.readFileSync('public/index.html','utf8'); html=html.replace(/\/build\/assets\/app-[^\"']+\.css/g, '/build/'+css).replace(/\/build\/assets\/app-[^\"']+\.js/g, '/build/'+js); fs.writeFileSync('public/index.html', html); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); fs.cpSync('public', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
